summary: Skratch announces the launch of Season 9 and shares a new redemption code, dragons9. Entering the code through the in-game settings grants 500 Dragon Crystals, 5 Heliolite Dice, 5,000,000 Gold, and other resources. He uses the rewarded Heliolite Dice to do five summons on the banner, obtaining several rare duplicates and an epic Horrus.
tips: Enter redemption code 'dragons9' in the settings menu under Redemption Code to receive 500 Dragon Crystals, 5 Heliolite Dice, and gold.
title: FREE REWARDS FOR EVERYONE! S9 Promo Code Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
